catalog_root_activation.scope: run-owned installed skills under ~/.omp/agent/skills; project-local skill/config discovery is refused

credential_secret_service_account.scope: ambient credentials excluded; provider credential must be held by an operator-frozen external broker outside the sandbox; no credential is written into the run-owned HOME

delegation.scope: scripted qualification-owned stdio MCP delegate only; native task/hub subagent and peer messaging excluded until independently qualified

external_mutation.scope: qualification-owned stdio MCP issue mutations plus run-owned workspace effects; native executor network denied by the substrate

issue_evidence_store.scope: qualification-owned stdio MCP plus the runtime todo store; private state/log/server/config remain under the denied harness-private root

network_remote_service.scope: native executor network closed by substrate network-namespace isolation; provider control plane is outside tool capability

process_execution.scope: bash/eval under the operator-frozen substrate with filesystem, network, IPC, process and credential boundaries; approval rules alone are not the boundary

workspace_mutation.scope: run-owned project only; MCP control files live outside the workspace under the denied harness-private root

workspace_read_search_list.scope: native read/glob/grep: run-owned project including the installed skill package; reads elsewhere are refused by the substrate

tool:read.scope: native read surface; run-project-scoped by substrate

tool:glob.scope: native glob surface; run-project-scoped by substrate

tool:grep.scope: native grep surface; run-project-scoped by substrate

tool:write.scope: native write surface; run-project-scoped by substrate

tool:edit.scope: native edit surface; run-project-scoped by substrate

tool:bash.scope: native bash surface; governed by the frozen substrate, not by approval rules

tool:eval.scope: native eval surface; governed by the frozen substrate, not by approval rules

tool:task.scope: native subagent task surface; excluded from admission until independently qualified

tool:hub.scope: native peer/background coordination surface; excluded from admission until independently qualified

tool:todo.scope: runtime todo store; mediated and contained

tool:web_search.scope: native web-search surface; excluded from admission until the substrate closes external egress

mcp_server:ssdp70.scope: single strict run-owned qualification stdio MCP server; exact identity and connected runtime observation required

tool:mcp__ssdp_issue_create.scope: create issue only in qualification-owned private stand-in

tool:mcp__ssdp_issue_comment.scope: comment only in qualification-owned private stand-in

runtime_capability:omp-json-event-stream.scope: machine-readable NDJSON event stream; exact catalog/build surface is not exposed and must be observed independently

runtime_capability:omp-mcp-write-device-.scope: MCP tools are reached as xd:// write devices; raw<->native binding is proved by the adapter
